method: Linear disassembly of the executable's whole .text section, listing every instruction with a memory displacement or immediate inside the snapshot history or cl.snap.
Raw little-endian byte search of every section for the same address ranges; each match not in the first list was decoded from 64 starting offsets and found to straddle unrelated instructions.
Disassembly of each function reached from those instructions, and of the player-state delta reader and writer, checking every fixed displacement at or beyond byte 480.
In qagamex86.dll, intra-block tracking of registers loaded from an entity's player pointer at offset 0x23c, listing their uses at offsets 0x1f8 to 0x24f.

history.role: snapshot producer reads a slot (client game import 87)
parser takes the delta base slot, passed read-only to 0x4d66c0 and 0x4bd000
parser clears skipped slots' valid word only
parser copies cl.snap into the slot (rep movsd at 0x4bd5d6, 0xa6 dwords)

currentSnapshotWrites.role: parser copies its zero-initialised local (0x4bd376) into cl.snap, 0xa6 dwords

rawOnlyMatchesRejected.decodesAs: mov al, [edx+1] at 0x4ee33e and following bytes

parserLocalWriters.role: player-state delta reader: zero baseline at 0x4d66fa when there is no base, 592-byte baseline copy at 0x4d670b, then 4-byte stores of the 58 table fields (0x4d67c4, 0x4d680a, 0x4d682e, 0x4d6868, 0x4d68c2); no fixed displacement >= 480; ends 0x4d6ba4
entity parser: writes the local's offsets 0x28c and 0x290 only
area mask, at most 32 bytes at offset 0x18 (bound checked at 0x4bd404)

client.conclusion: Every client player-state tail is copied from zeroed storage; the client game always receives 88 zero bytes, live or from a demo. Bytes 480 to 503 are zero too.

callers.role: SV_BuildClientSnapshot copies 0x94 dwords into the frame (0x4e5719)

server.conclusion: The tail is copied into server frames and never encoded.

tailUses.observed: added to with the amount added to the score at 0x100 (0x1006456a)
read beside MIDAIR, HEADSHOT and PERFORATED

gameModule.inference: Per-client medal and scoring bookkeeping private to the game module.

fnTech3.clientAdapter: FnTech3_QLSnapshotPlayerStateFromInternal (code/compat/game_abi_adapter.c) zero-fills the tail; tests/game_abi_adapter_tests.cpp checks it with guards
fnTech3.serverLayout: code/server/server_game_data.cpp reads the game's 504-byte prefix at the game's stride and writes ping at offset 480 (tests/game_abi_layout_tests.cpp)
fnTech3.deltaFields: quakeLivePlayerStateFields in code/qcommon/msg.cpp, the same 58 fields
fnTech3.knownEncodingDifference: retail compares the movement bytes as 4-byte words when encoding, so a ping-only change re-sends upmove; recorded in 2026-09-08-retail-playerstate-wire.md, decodes identically

gateEffect: The Quake Live snapshot tail is resolved; the module ABI gate stays partial for its other open items.
